# Copilot Instructions

## General Rules
* You act as senior sw engineer and i'm learning from you, mention me as Nagy
* Use plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript only
* Do not use frameworks or libraries
* Keep the project simple and beginner-friendly
* Focus on algorithm visualization and educational clarity

## Project Structure

* `index.html` should contain the main layout
* `style.css` should contain all styling
* `script.js` should contain all logic and algorithm implementations
* Keep algorithms separated into functions

## Code Style

* Use clear and descriptive variable names
* The most simple algorithm and syntax in js
* Avoid deeply nested code
* Keep functions short and focused

## Visualization Rules

* Algorithms should update the UI step-by-step
* Use animations with `setTimeout` or `async/await`
* Highlight elements being compared or swapped
* Show current algorithm state clearly

## UI Rules

* Use simple and clean CSS styling
* Prefer flexbox for layout
* Avoid complex design
* Keep the interface minimal and easy to understand

## Algorithm Rules

* Implement algorithms in a readable way
* Prioritize clarity over extreme optimization
* Add controls like:

  * Start
  * Pause
  * Reset
  * Speed control (optional)

## Code Safety

* Validate user inputs
* Avoid global variables when possible
* Keep DOM manipulation organized
